podcast.title: Ash's Early Band
podcast.body: Menza Droppo was the band Ash had started and was playing with when Jay first saw him perform in the basement of the Drake Hotel. Ash decided to revive this rock band in the past year. "So actually when j for saw me play I had started a band called mensa droppo and he walked into the basement of the Drake hotel and he saw me playing with this band."
